threats.threat: An authenticated tenant can request another tenant file by changing the object identifier.
threats.mitigation: Bind lookup to the authenticated tenant and object identifier; deny mismatches.
threats.validation: local toy cross-tenant denial test; production implementation not verified

threats.threat: An upload exceeds permitted size or type and consumes service resources.
threats.mitigation: Enforce size and type rules at ingress and storage; add rejection tests.

threats.threat: File access cannot be attributed because the service records no access event.
threats.mitigation: Record tenant, object, action, outcome and server timestamp with restricted append access.

exhaustiveness: 42 considered cells demonstrate enumeration coverage; not evidence all threats were found
